title: Organizer handles event admissions and unpaid fees
description: On a paid Event, read the check-in window and handle pending or unpaid event fees (Record cash / Clear unpaid).

steps.title: Event check-in window
steps.body: Check-in time is when event admissions open. Players who check in inside that window use the event fee instead of a separate club-day charge.
steps.resultNote: Tutorial Event Night shows Time and Check-in time.

steps.title: Unpaid event fee
steps.body: Finley Ortiz still has a pending event fee. Record cash at the desk or Clear unpaid if they will not pay.
steps.actionHint: Find Record cash or Clear unpaid
